real_defects.issue: The body of a RUN/COPY/ADD heredoc was read as Dockerfile instructions, in both the page (classify.mjs) and the CLI (check.py): `COPY <<EOF /srv/Dockerfile` writing a nested `FROM alpine:latest` was reported as a mutable base image of the outer file (repro: scanText of the HEREDOC_FILE fixture gave 3 findings, now 2). Fixed with heredocTerminators/heredoc_terminators skipping each body to its terminator (<<-, quoted names, fd prefixes, several on one line).

`COPY . .` then `RUN <<EOF` / `npm ci` / `EOF` parsed as a RUN of "<<EOF" with no install, so the file passed clean while `RUN npm ci` on one line was flagged install-missing-manifest-copy. Fixed: a RUN heredoc's body joins that RUN's args; a COPY/ADD body is dropped, never read as instructions.

Same heredoc class: a `FROM node:16` inside `COPY <<EOF` (a nested Dockerfile) was read as this Dockerfile's Node pin and reported as disagreeing with .nvmrc 22. Found by the new platform/ci/check_dockerfile_heredoc.py on its first run; fixed the same way.
